name: Walrein
description: Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals. When a threat appears, the herd’s leader will protect the group with its life.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the target’s HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description: The target faints instantly. It’s less likely to hit the target if it’s used by Pokémon other than Ice types.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the target’s HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.
